text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Egypt's official Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said it bought 100,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat and 50,000 tonnes of either Australian or U.S. hard red wheat. Shipment was slated for April-May delivery.

CORN TENDER - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association will tender on Thursday for a 26,000-tonne shipment of U.S. wheat, traders said. The tender specifies that the shipment include Dark Northern Spring, Hard Red Winter and White Wheat, all slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

WHEAT TENDER - Iraq is still negotiating the import of 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat and a reply is expected later on Monday or on Tuesday, European grain traders said. Iraq has been negotiating the purchase under a U.N. oil-for-food deal with exporters since Friday. The lowest-priced offers received by Iraq stood at around $199-$208 per tonne, c and f, for delivery to Jordan's port of Aqaba, exporters said.

- France will hold a tender on March 26 to sell 3,000 tonnes of soft wheat to Iraq via the Rome-based World Food Programme, national grain office ONIC said. The wheat is for shipment between April 8 and April 30.

- The Cyprus Grain Commission has changed the deadline for the submission of tenders for the supply of a combined cargo of 10,000 tonnes of spring and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat to March 27, it said in a statement. The commission had earlier issued another announcement saying the deadline was March 28. All other terms in the initial tender issued remain the same, it said. Shipment of the cargo is scheduled to take place between April 5 and 20.
VEGOIL TENDER - Egypt was seeking up to 45,000 tonnes of assorted vegetable oils for delivery in May 1997. The deadline for all bids was on April 2.
BARLEY TENDER - The South African Wheat Board said it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale no later than April 30.

RICE TENDERS - Costa Rica suspended its buy tender for 30,000 tonnes of rice because of high prices from the 16 companies that tendered, an official from Granos Basicos de CentroAmerica said Monday. Alvaro Cordero, executive director of the private company in charge of the tender for the industrial rice sector, said it had decided to suspend the tender and re-open it in late April, looking for lower prices.
RICE TENDERS - Syria seeks 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20. April 8 is the final date for bids, and results will be announced on April 16.

MARKET TALK - Taiwan edible oil producers said on Monday they were considering exporting soymeal to China as the island's pork export crisis sent soybean inventories soaring and local prices falling. "The massive slaughter of pigs will significantly reduce demand for soymeal," Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Co official Jack Lee told Reuters.
... Corn prices are likely to drop further in the wake of the foot-and-mouth disease which crippled Taiwan's pork industry, traders said.
